QuestInfo.name: Audience with the Queen
QuestInfo.0: #p9074200# now has both Silk and a diamond! Maybe he'll finally be brave enough to meet the queen.
QuestInfo.1: #p9074200# thinks he smells bad, which he does, but now he wants you to get him some new cologne. Anyway, go take out some #o9810202# in the Red Desert and get a good stock of #t4033214# for #p9074200#.
QuestInfo.2: #p9074200# put on the #t4033214# Cologne and left for his audience with #p9074201#.

0.0: Silk and diamond... finally enough for a queen! But I feel like there's something missing. A little bit of the old world flair, if you know what I mean.

yes.0: The queen isn't going to accept me with the stink of the desert pouring from every fold of fabric. I need a cover-up cologne. Something fragrant, like the cacti on top of #o9810202#'s head! That's why the Red Desert is so pleasantly odoriferous, don't you know?

no.0: Are you saying no? What will I give the queen?!
